{{Quote|On my end, I'm running down a slippery recruiter with links to Heta. I have the local Dar'manda on Mek-Sha to thank for the lead.|[[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]]|<ref name="TOR:RA">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|Relentless Ambitions|Odessen}}</ref>}}
'''Gauss''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] recruiter who was affiliated with the [[Hidden Chain]].<ref name="Snare"/>

==Biography==
Extremely wealthy, Gauss recruited individuals for the most dangerous people in the galaxy. Around the time of the [[Third Galactic War]], he was recruiting for the [[Hidden Chain]], which made him extremely wealthy. He caught the attention of [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]], who hoped to use him to gain information on [[Heta Kol]]. She chased him across [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] and [[Darvannis]], where each time he used his extraordinary wealth to evade capture.<ref name="Snare"/> Around [[3625 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|7.1}}</ref> she finally [[Mission to Nar Shaddaa (Mandalore the Avenger)|tracked him down]] to the [[Duros Sector]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], where he hired [[Rubassa]] and other [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] from [[Clan Ha'rangir]] to prevent Shae from following him. Rubassa manged to do this, and helped Gauss flee, though Shae's target had changed to Rubassa. It is unknown what happened to Gauss after this.<ref name="Snare"/>
